events.title: Howard Kendall resigns after three years in his second spell as charge of 에버턴, who have fallen into the bottom half of the Premier League table after topping it in the first month of the season. Curiously, Kendall's resignation comes within hours of 에버턴's 1–0 home league win over 사우샘프턴. 맨체스터 유나이티드 and 노리치 시티 draw 2–2 in a thrilling match at Old Trafford, while second placed Leeds beat 맨체스터 시티 3–2 at Elland Road.
라치오 deny rumours that 폴 개스코인 is due to return to English football in a move to either 리즈 유나이티드 or 맨체스터 유나이티드.
Former England manager 보비 롭슨 resigns as manager of Portuguese side 스포르팅, sparking media speculation that he will be offered the 에버턴 job.
리버풀 are held to a 2–2 at home to bottom club Swindon in the Premier League, although the visitors still have just one league win to their names after 20 matches.

São Paulo FC once again wins the Intercontinental Cup in FC 도쿄, Japan , this time by defeating Italy 's AC 밀란 , 3–2. The winning goal for the Brazilians is scored by Müller in the 86th minute. European Cup winners 마르세유 (France) were suspended due to a bribery scandal in the French Championship and were replaced by runners-up AC 밀란.
노샘프턴 타운 , who are bottom of Division Three, dismiss manager Phil Chard and replace him with John Barnwell .

The main Premier League action sees 셰필드 웬즈데이 win 5–0 at home over 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 토트넘 홋스퍼 draw 3–3 at home to 리버풀. Swindon win for the second time in the Premier League this season and for the first time at home by beating 사우샘프턴 2–1.
With three of the game's four goals coming during the closing few minutes, 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 애스턴 빌라 3–1 at Old Trafford to go 13 points ahead at the top of the Premier League.
David Rocastle leaves Leeds after 16 months to sign for 맨체스터 시티 in a £2million, after 데이비드 화이트 went in the opposite direction for the same fee.
The Boxing Day action sees a late equaliser from 폴 인스 give 맨체스터 유나이티드 a 1–1 draw at home to 블랙번 로버스 after Kevin Gallacher had put the visitors ahead.

Kevin Campbell scores his second league hat-trick of the season as 아스널 beat 스윈던 타운 4–0 at the County Ground . Meanwhile, 아스널's underperforming North London rivals 토트넘 홋스퍼 are beaten 3–1 at home by a 노리치 시티 side with two goals coming from prolific 20-year-old striker Chris Sutton . In Division One, 레스터 시티 draw 4–4 with 왓퍼드 in a thrilling match at Filbert Street, and Southend climb back into the top six with a 4–2 home win over fourth-placed Charlton.

맨체스터 유나이티드 beat Oldham 5–2 at Boundary Park in a match where 안드레이 칸첼스키스 scores twice for the defending champions, who now lead the Premier League by 14 points. Swindon keep up their fight for survival by battling out it for a 3–3 draw at 셰필드 웬즈데이.

Lawrie McMenemy , 사우샘프턴 manager from 1973 to 1985 and until last month assistant manager of the England team since 1990, returns to The Dell as Director of Football, working alongside under-fire manager Ian Branfoot .

The year draws to a close with 맨체스터 유나이티드 still top of the table with a 14-point lead over nearest rivals 블랙번 로버스, who have a game in hand. 리즈 유나이티드, 아스널 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 complete the top five, while at the other end of the table 스윈던 타운 remain bottom with 올덤 애슬레틱 and 첼시 now out of the relegation zone at the expense of 사우샘프턴 and 셰필드 유나이티드. 크리스털 팰리스 are now leaders of Division One, with the other automatic promotion place currently being occupied by 트랜미어 로버스. 찰턴 애슬레틱, 레스터 시티 and 사우스엔드 유나이티드 complete the top six. 노팅엄 포리스트 are catching up with the leading pack and are now just one point and two places outside the playoff zone.
